name: comp-476
title: Feature Compatibility Table
blurb: Browser compatibility matrix with rotated headers and support indicators.
description: Displays CSS feature support across desktop and mobile browsers with version numbers. Each cell shows a checkmark or X with browser version in a compact, scannable grid with sideways-oriented headers.
use_when: Documenting feature support across browsers, building reference tables for CSS capabilities.
avoid_when: When data is dynamic or needs frequent updates — data is hardcoded in the component.
a11y: Icon indicators are aria-hidden with sr-only text fallbacks for "Supported" and "Not supported". Column headers include sr-only text identifying Desktop/Mobile groups.
